[Gb5]Tell me, re-
mind me
Chase the water racing from
the sky
Always be-
side me
Taste the memories running from
my eyes

[Pre-Chorus]
[Gb5]Nervous flashlights
[E5]scan my dreams
[D5]Liquid shadows
[B5]silence [Gb5]their screams I
[Gb5]smile at the moon Chasing
[E5]water from the sky I
[D5]argue with the clouds Stealing
[B5]beauty [Gb5]from my eyes

[Chorus]
[Db5]Outside the sound-
ness of your mind
[B5]
[Db5]Bathing your
soul in
[B5]silver tears
[Db5]Beneath a black-
ened summer sky
[B5]
[Db5]Praying for time
to disappear
[B5]
[Gb5]

mer sky
Under glass
moonlight
Night awaits
the lamb's arri-

dows crawl

drops fall
The bride subsides
to her survi-
